tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Tenders from Joint ventures are not acceptable

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.
The tenderer should be registered with the Karnataka Labour Department for the supply of manpower. The agency shall provide the valid registration certificate for the concurrent period

The tenderes whose contracts have been terminated / fore closed by any employer during the previous years due to non fulfilment of contractual obligations / non compliance of statutory obligations are not eligible to bid. The tenderer should clearly specify and submit declaration stating that they do not fall under this category
The tenderer should have registered with Goods and service tax department and furnish the registration certificate
List of existing commitments and ongoing work
The tenderer should have registered with EPF and ESI departments and should furnish certified copies of registration along with enrolment numbers
The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of eProcurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end
Work done/Experience Certificate issued by the Head of the Department for providing services of contract amount not less than Rs.3.68 lakhs at least one Similar nature of work (Manpower supply)
The tenderer in his name should have in the last 5 year period achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover of Rs. 7.35 lakhs
The tenderer should scan and upload the original Annual turnover certificates for last five financial years i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26 obtained from the Auditor/Chartered Accountant.
Man power rates/wages in the tenders are subjected to modifications as per government order and circulars.
The tenderer should quote the Service Charges in Indian Rupees only.,
